title: Philosophy Of Education
modules: Meaning, Scope And Functions Of Philosophy
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the rightness or wrongness of an action."
Ethics is concerned with the rightness or wrongness of an action.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of education which takes place through interaction with elders, age mates, and friends."
Informal education is a process of education which takes place through interaction with elders, age mates, and friends.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible to select the laws for nature which denote good and conduct himself by such laws."
Moral man is responsible to select the laws for nature which denote good and conduct himself by such laws.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act by which the mind proceeding from a judgment moves to a second judgment and from there to a third judgment which is the peak of our mental processes."
Reasoning is the act by which the mind proceeding from a judgment moves to a second judgment and from there to a third judgment which is the peak of our mental processes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a simple, peaceable, happy and contended individual."
Man in his natural state is a simple, peaceable, happy and contended individual.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as follows: As that which does not appear to the sense, abstract concept, such as essence, existence, goodness etc. explanation of the nature of being or reality per se."
Metaphysics can be defined as follows: As that which does not appear to the sense, abstract concept, such as essence, existence, goodness etc. explanation of the nature of being or reality per se.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from the Greek word 'axios' meaning worthy, and 'logos' meaning discourse."
Axiology is derived from the Greek word 'axios' meaning worthy, and 'logos' meaning discourse.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sign of being an educated person."
Being critical is a sign of being an educated person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of socialisation and an instrument of national development when it is best utilized."
Education is a process of socialisation and an instrument of national development when it is best utilized.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fruitful ordering of subject matter designed to produce knowledge, skills and attitude in our children."
Curriculum design is the fruitful ordering of subject matter designed to produce knowledge, skills and attitude in our children.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the judge of what is of value to him."
Existentialists believe that man is the judge of what is of value to him.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of philosophy which is concerned with the theories of the nature of knowledge."
Epistemology is a branch of philosophy which is concerned with the theories of the nature of knowledge.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the "reconstruction or reorganisation of experience which adds to the meaning of experience and increases the ability to direct the course of subsequent experience"."
Dewey says that education is the "reconstruction or reorganisation of experience which adds to the meaning of experience and increases the ability to direct the course of subsequent experience".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the uses of the subject to us as individuals and as members of a society."
The functions of philosophy are the uses of the subject to us as individuals and as members of a society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the use of philosophical tools, theories, methods, and principles for the explanation and solutions of educational problems."
Philosophy of education is the use of philosophical tools, theories, methods, and principles for the explanation and solutions of educational problems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the science of good reasoning."
Logic may be defined as the science of good reasoning.
